description:
[0.98a] Starsector Language Pack - French v2.0.0-rc2

French translation mod for Starsector 0.98a-RC8.

What's translated:

40,000+ lines of dialogue, quests, events (rules.csv)Full Codex (Spacer's Handbook — combat, UI, tech types)Skills, hullmods, weapons, ship systemsFactions, ranks, fleet namesMissions, tooltips, loading tipsShip names, commodities, industries

Known limitations:

Some UI labels remain in English (hardcoded in Java): deployment panel, combat HUD (FLUX, HULL, CR), character creation screen. A detailed report has been sent to Alex.

Download:

GitHub Release v2.0.0-rc2

Installation:

1. Download the ZIP

2. Extract into mods/

3. Enable in launcher

4. New game recommended

Compatibility:

Compatible with any mod that doesn't override the same vanilla data files (rules.csv, descriptions.csv, strings.json). Most gameplay/ship/faction mods work fine.

Feedback & bugs:

GitHub Issues

GitHub Repository

aiDescription: Provides a comprehensive French translation for Starsector 0.98a, covering the Codex, skills, hullmods, weapons, ship systems, factions, and missions. Includes a Java mod plugin to translate hardcoded UI text without modifying vanilla files. Compatible with major content mods like Nexerelin, LunaLib, and MagicLib.

changelog.2.0.15:
This release fixes a critical incompatibility between the French Language Pack and Nexerelin.

Until now, players running the French Language Pack alongside Nexerelin (with its dependencies LazyLib and MagicLib) experienced two separate crashes: one when loading the game, and another when starting a new game, where the Nexerelin faction selection screen failed to appear. In practice, this made the French Language Pack unusable for a large portion of the community, since Nexerelin is one of the most widely installed mods for Starsector.

Both crashes are now fixed. The French Language Pack is fully compatible with Nexerelin: the game loads correctly, new games start as expected with the faction selection screen, and all French translations remain intact.

If you previously had to choose between the French Language Pack and Nexerelin, you no longer have to. We recommend updating to v2.0.15.
changelog.2.0.13:
Starsector loads only one strings.json — first mod in enabled_mods.json wins, no merge. The FR pack was listed first and silently overwrote UI keys from your other mods.

Fixed:
 LunaLib : Save All / Reset / keyboard shortcuts
 MagicLib : bounties, achievements, paintjobs, subsystems
 Tahlan Shipworks : full UI
 UAF + Diable Avionics : all UI keys intact

40,000+ lines translated. Compatible 0.98a-RC8.
